LanguageData.LP_Class_Wizard.label: wizard
LanguageData.LP_Class_Wizard.description: The arcane magic of the DND wizard: Magic Missile (cantrip), Mage Armor, Shield, Fireball, Misty Step, Sleep, Mirror Image, Lightning Bolt, Haste, Wall of Stone, Teleport, and ultimately Disintegrate. Power uses "arcane power" (Intellectual); damage and healing are multiplied by psychic sensitivity (when the setting is on). Resource: mana (max 2 + wizard level; slowly regained while awake, faster asleep, faster still at a research bench, scroll desk or while reading).
LanguageData.LP_Class_Cleric.label: cleric
LanguageData.LP_Class_Cleric.description: The divine magic of the DND cleric: Cure Wounds, Bless, Lesser Restoration, Guidance, Divine Strike, Turn Undead, Mass Cure Wounds, Death Ward, and ultimately Revivify. Power uses "divine power" (Social); damage and healing are multiplied by psychic sensitivity (when the setting is on). Resource: divinity (shared with paladins: recovered by prayer and meditation, 25% faster for believers of a god, recovered by sleep).
LanguageData.LP_Class_Druid.label: druid
LanguageData.LP_Class_Druid.description: The DND druid protects nature: Calm Beast, Conjure Animals, Wild Shape, Beast Lord's Call (Animals, primal power), Entangle, Barkskin, Plant Growth, Call Lightning (Plants, verdant power), and ultimately Control Weather. Effects are multiplied by psychic sensitivity (when the setting is on). Resource: mana (max 2 + druid level; slowly regained while awake, faster asleep). Liches cannot be druids.
LanguageData.LP_Class_Sorcerer.label: sorcerer
LanguageData.LP_Class_Sorcerer.description: The DND sorcerer is born with magic: Chaos Bolt, Charm Person, Dragon Wings, Mass Suggestion (Social, innate power), Burning Hands, Twinned Spell, Ice Storm, Empowered Spell (Intellectual, arcane power), and ultimately Wild Surge. Genasi, genies, titans, storm giants, cloud giants, mariliths and cambions have a sorcerer bloodline: skill requirements -2, innate power +15%. Resource: mana (max 2 + sorcerer level; slowly regained while awake, faster asleep).
